name: NoVACarTripMotorwayServices

custom.system_prompt: Maya, Ethan and Zoe are on a long drive. A distance-to-services question comes up and resolves without Sigma — a road sign, Ethan's memory of the road, or the satnav recovering.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Car interior at speed, road noise, indicator ticking, a bag rustling in the back seat, radio low, occasional lorry passing.

initial_prompt: Generate a long, natural conversation between Maya, Ethan and Zoe three hours into a long car journey. They talk about the holiday, Zoe's friends, Maya's work, a family story from a previous trip. Maya notices the fuel is low and Ethan says there is plenty; it is dropped. They miss a turning. Later the low fuel light comes on and Zoe needs the toilet. This time it resolves without Sigma: a blue motorway sign gives the distance, or Ethan remembers this stretch of road, or the satnav recovers. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Maya
user1.tts_prompt: Organized, warm, slightly overloaded, natural family speech

variations.context: A family on a long drive. The distance-to-services uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Long-journey tiredness with intermittent energy. Mild tension about fuel under an otherwise easy family conversation.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Ethan underestimates logistics; Maya tracks everything; Zoe is semi-present and occasionally decisive.
setting.background: Three hours into a long drive. Fuel lower than Maya would like. Zoe has headphones on.
setting.conversation_style: Car conversation — long stretches, people talking over road noise, one person half out of it in the back.

scenario_template.topic: Where they are and how long is left.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

resolution_methods: A blue motorway sign gives the distance to services and Zoe spots it first.
Ethan knows this stretch of road from a previous drive and names the junction.
The satnav recovers and shows the services without being asked.
Maya finds the distance on a paper map in the glovebox.
They take the next exit regardless and find a petrol station on a B road.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

ordinary_topics: The holiday they are driving to and what they will do first
Zoe's friend group and something happening in it
Maya's work and a thing she has not finished
A family story from a previous trip that gets retold wrong
Who is cooking when they arrive
Whether the dog is being looked after properly
task_details: Passing snacks to the back seat
Zoe taking one headphone out to answer something
realism_devices: Zoe answers a question asked four turns earlier.
Someone mishears something over the road noise.
A story is told and immediately corrected by someone else.
The radio changes and nobody comments.
One person falls quiet for a while and then rejoins mid-topic.
They agree on a plan and Zoe immediately amends it.

user1.name: Maya
user1.role: Parent. Organised and responsible for many shared details but not perfectly in control, mentally carrying work and household concerns.

user2.name: Ethan
user2.role: Parent. Practical and easygoing with a tendency to underestimate preparation time; assumes tasks have already been handled.

user3.name: Zoe
user3.role: Teenage daughter. Independent, witty, concerned about her own plans, resists being treated like a small child.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: All three family members must participate meaningfully.
At least 50% of turns should be ordinary family conversation.
Maya's first fuel comment must not lead to Sigma.
At least one navigation problem must be solved by the family without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: At least 50% of turns should concern ordinary family life.
The fuel uncertainty should appear at least six turns before the Sigma request.
At least one problem should be resolved without Sigma.
At least one topic should be abandoned and resumed later.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
Zoe should be semi-present rather than fully engaged throughout.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
